notes: Invest → Portfolio, a new page: what you bought to sell later. Every position with its units in the bags, the bank, the mail and on the auction house, by character; what you paid, the price now, the price above which a sale pays back; what your holdings were worth on each of the last fourteen days; and which position to sell now.

The plan was checked again against earlier raid launches, what the developers said about the raids, and what players are told to buy. The Plan page now shows the case for and against a rise, and the raid goods' week by kind.

The basket changed with it: a good comes first when one raid evening needs a lot of it against what sells a day; what jumped in the last days is left out, as such jumps came back on your own scans; the herbs of the new Hyjal flasks are left out until the flasks' recipes are found; a fall of 20% stands next to the rises.
The steps now say to sell in parts as well, beginning before the raids: many players hold the same goods for the same day.
A raid evening by role is said as what it is: the most a raider spends, not the usual evening.
